criteria.name: Written communication with customers
criteria.topic: writing clear, kind answers to customers
criteria.question: Tell me about a written answer to a customer that you are proud of. What did the customer need, what did you write, and what happened next?

criteria.name: Troubleshooting and diagnosing problems
criteria.topic: finding the cause of a customer's problem
criteria.question: Walk me through a problem you could not see the cause of at first. How did you narrow it down?

criteria.name: Support tools and systems
criteria.topic: working in a ticket queue, chat and a knowledge base
criteria.question: Which support tools have you used every day, and how did you keep records useful for the next person?

criteria.name: Calm handling of upset customers
criteria.topic: calming a customer who is upset
criteria.question: Describe a conversation with a very upset customer. What did you say first, and how did it end?

criteria.name: Improving how the team works
criteria.topic: improving a support process or help article
criteria.question: Tell me about a change you made so the same customer problem happened less often.

criteria.name: Scheduling and coordinating people and deliveries
criteria.topic: planning schedules for people and deliveries
criteria.question: Tell me about a week when the plan fell apart. How did you re-plan it?

criteria.name: Working with suppliers
criteria.question: Describe a supplier problem you had to sort out and how you handled the conversation.

criteria.name: Tracking work in spreadsheets and reports
criteria.topic: tracking work and stock in spreadsheets
criteria.question: Show me how you keep track of orders or stock. How do you avoid mistakes?

criteria.name: Writing and improving routines
criteria.topic: writing down and improving a routine
criteria.question: Tell me about a routine you wrote or changed. How did you know it worked?

criteria.name: Cost awareness
criteria.question: Tell me about a time you found a cost that could be cut. What did you do?

criteria.name: Querying data with SQL
criteria.question: Describe a hard query you wrote. How did you check that the numbers were right?

criteria.name: Charts and dashboards
criteria.question: Tell me about a dashboard you built. Who used it and what did they decide with it?

criteria.name: Statistics and tests
criteria.question: Describe a time you compared two options with numbers. How sure were you, and why?

criteria.name: Cleaning and checking data
criteria.question: Tell me about wrong data you found. How did you find it and how did you stop it coming back?

criteria.name: Explaining findings to non specialists
criteria.topic: explaining results to people who are not analysts
criteria.question: Tell me about explaining an analysis to someone who does not work with data. What did they do afterwards?
